observations.why: The act of switching to a new database technology appeals to novelty and self-direction as the motivating good.
Quantified performance gain appeals to achievement and mastery; cost reduction appeals to competitive standing.
The arrow notation frames the migration as a directional move toward novelty, restating the openness-to-change appeal.
Quantified analytical performance gain appeals to mastery and achievement as the motivating good.
Setting a concrete timeline expresses the competence need — organizing and committing to deliverable capability.
